lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 10 to 12 distinct white vertical lines traversing the orange-brown torso. Spacing is narrowest at the anterior shoulder and widest across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A singular bifurcation is visible at the dorsal terminus of the fourth primary line from the anterior, where a small secondary segment merges into the ridge line.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The first anterior line is truncated, terminating mid-shoulder. The posterior-most line segments on the upper rump are abbreviated and do not extend to the ventral line.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Two high-contrast white spots are visible on the lower posterior haunch, positioned approximately at the level of the stifles.

other_distinctive_markers: A prominent white chevron-shaped band is visible across the bridge of the muzzle between the eyes. White hair fringes are visible on the inner margins of the large pinnae.
